# SummerTimelockController
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/gov-contracts/src/contracts/SummerTimelockController.sol)

**Inherits:**
TimelockController

**Title:**
SummerTimelockController

Timelock controller for Summer governance that adds guardian-aware cancellation and special
handling for guardian-expiry operations on top of OpenZeppelin's TimelockController.


## State Variables
### accessManager
The ProtocolAccessManager used to resolve governor and guardian roles


```solidity
IProtocolAccessManager public immutable accessManager
```


### _guardianExpiryOperations

```solidity
mapping(bytes32 => bool) private _guardianExpiryOperations
```


## Functions
### constructor


```solidity
constructor(
    uint256 minDelay,
    address[] memory proposers,
    address[] memory executors,
    address admin,
    address _accessManager
)
    TimelockController(minDelay, proposers, executors, admin);
```

### cancel

Cancels a scheduled timelock operation, enforcing guardian-aware authorization rules

Override of the TimelockController's cancel function to support guardian-based cancellation
with special handling for guardian expiry proposals.
Cancellation rules:
1. Guardian expiry proposals can ONLY be cancelled by governors
2. Governors with cancel role can cancel any other proposal
3. Active guardians with cancel role can cancel any non-expiry proposal


```solidity
function cancel(bytes32 id) public virtual override;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`id`|`bytes32`|The identifier of the operation to cancel|


### _isGuardianExpiryProposal

Checks if the provided operation data corresponds to a guardian expiry proposal.
Guardian expiry proposals are special operations that set the expiration time for guardians.
These proposals have additional restrictions on who can cancel them to prevent guardians
from blocking their own expiry mechanisms.


```solidity
function _isGuardianExpiryProposal(bytes32 id) internal view returns (bool);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|bool True if the operation is a guardian expiry proposal|


### _isGovernorWithCancelRole

Checks if an account is a governor with cancellation privileges.
To have governor cancellation rights, an account must:
1. Have the CANCELLER_ROLE in this contract
2. Have the GOVERNOR_ROLE in the access manager
Governors with the CANCELLER_ROLE can cancel any proposal.


```solidity
function _isGovernorWithCancelRole(address account) internal view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`account`|`address`|The address to check|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|bool True if the account is a governor with cancel rights|


### _isActiveGuardianWithCancelRole

Checks if an account is an active guardian with cancellation privileges.
To have guardian cancellation rights, an account must:
1. Have the CANCELLER_ROLE in this contract
2. Be an active guardian in the access manager
Active guardians with cancel rights can cancel any proposal EXCEPT guardian
expiry proposals, which can only be cancelled by governors.


```solidity
function _isActiveGuardianWithCancelRole(address account) internal view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`account`|`address`|The address to check|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|bool True if the account is an active guardian with cancel rights|


### schedule

Schedules a single operation, flagging it if it sets a guardian expiration

Override schedule to track guardian expiry operations. Callable only by PROPOSER_ROLE.


```solidity
function schedule(
    address target,
    uint256 value,
    bytes calldata data,
    bytes32 predecessor,
    bytes32 salt,
    uint256 delay
)
    public
    virtual
    override
    onlyRole(PROPOSER_ROLE);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`target`|`address`|The address the operation will call|
|`value`|`uint256`|The native token value to send with the call|
|`data`|`bytes`|The calldata of the operation|
|`predecessor`|`bytes32`|The id of a predecessor operation that must execute first (or zero)|
|`salt`|`bytes32`|A salt to disambiguate otherwise-identical operations|
|`delay`|`uint256`|The delay, in seconds, before the operation becomes executable|


### scheduleBatch

Schedules a batch of operations, flagging the batch if any payload sets a guardian expiration

Override scheduleBatch to track guardian expiry operations. Callable only by PROPOSER_ROLE.


```solidity
function scheduleBatch(
    address[] calldata targets,
    uint256[] calldata values,
    bytes[] calldata payloads,
    bytes32 predecessor,
    bytes32 salt,
    uint256 delay
)
    public
    virtual
    override
    onlyRole(PROPOSER_ROLE);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`targets`|`address[]`|The addresses each operation will call|
|`values`|`uint256[]`|The native token values to send with each call|
|`payloads`|`bytes[]`|The calldata for each operation|
|`predecessor`|`bytes32`|The id of a predecessor operation that must execute first (or zero)|
|`salt`|`bytes32`|A salt to disambiguate otherwise-identical batches|
|`delay`|`uint256`|The delay, in seconds, before the batch becomes executable|
